decisions.reason: The source modifies the displayed slogan for the bottle-and-cloud design only; it does not necessarily change the independently specified slogan capitalization on the stamped-meat design.
The source is scoped by the adjacent context to the bottle-and-cloud design and does not modify the slogan rendered as smoke in the separate grill design.
The Riverton sky text requirement does not contain the campfire slogan and is unaffected by the bottle design's slogan correction.
Changing displayed slogan text in one illustration does not alter the hand-drawn, non-AI production-method requirement.
